item.title: Italy's innovation capacity in a European comparison
item.description: Italy’s innovation capacity in a European comparison Measuring a country’s innovation capacity with a single number is inevitably reductive. However, a useful indicator for an initial comparison is research and development intensity, defined as gross domestic expenditure on R&D as a share of GDP. This indicator shows how many resources an economy devotes to producing new knowledge and developing new applications. It does not directly measure the quality of research, the number of innovations introduced to the market, or their economic productivity.
